## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits format (`type(scope): subject`)
- [ ] Subject line is 72 characters or fewer, imperative mood
- [ ] Lint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Format check passes (`npm run format:check`)
- [ ] Unit tests pass with coverage >= 85% (`npm test`)
- [ ] No-emoji check passes (`npm run check:no-emoji`)
- [ ] No secrets in the diff
- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] No hardcoded URLs, keys or magic numbers
- [ ] No `console.log` - structured logger used throughout
- [ ] No TODO without a linked entry in `docs/known-limitations.md`
- [ ] CI green on all required jobs before merge
